title: Support SLA Policy by Customer Tier (v1)
author: Rachel Kim
body:
## Purpose
First response targets for Support tickets by customer tier.

## First response targets
| Priority | Self-serve (Hosted API) | Dedicated | Private | Enterprise |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **P0** | 2 hours (BH) | 30 min (24/7) | 30 min (24/7) | 15 min (24/7) |
| **P1** | 8 hours (BH) | 60 min (24/7) | 60 min (24/7) | 30 min (24/7) |
| **P2** | 2 business days | 8 hours (BH) | 8 hours (BH) | 4 hours (BH) |
| **P3** | 2 business days | 2 business days | 2 business days | 1 business day |
| **P4** | 5 business days | 5 business days | 5 business days | 2 business days |

## Notes
- Dedicated and Private P0/P1 are covered 24/7; everything else is business hours.
- Update cadence is agreed per ticket with the customer.

- **2025-09-30:** Minor wording fixes.
- **2025-03-12:** Initial publication.
